patch_description: Implements the recommended fix: remove the gradient-slope blend entirely (the identified noise leak) and drive the trend-compensation lead using only the SG-smoothed RTS slope state. The pipeline is: (1) 2-state [level, slope] Kalman filter with Q scaled by median |diff| (the proven best tuning from Gens with lag 0.24–0.27), (2) RTS backward smoother for zero-phase lag reduction, (3) a single short zero-phase SG pass on the already-denoised level and slope channels to kill residual micro-oscillations that drive slope_changes/false_reversals, (4) a sigmoid confidence gate (center 0.25·q_scale, temperature 0.15·q_scale) applied to the pure SG-smoothed RTS slope so the lead scales with trend confidence — weak/ambiguous slopes get near-zero lead (no noise amplification), strong confirmed trends get the full lead = 0.5·sg_half·0.25, (5) the localized reversal-suppression hysteresis for any remaining weak flipping-gradient neighborhoods. This targets Gen 45's lag (0.27) combined with Gen 46's smoothness (0.30) in one program, without reintroducing the gradient noise that regressed Gens 50/52 to 0.63.
